title: VIU Board Games Club
text:
Welcome to the VIU Board Games Club!
We’re a community of Vancouver Island University students who love bringing people together over great games. Whether you’re into classic board games, strategy-heavy challenges, party games, or just curious to try something new, there’s a seat for you at our table.
We offer regular game nights, a growing library of games, and an inclusive space to meet new people, unwind, and have fun between classes. No experience required, just show up and play!
JOIN US

title: Join Us
text:
What Happens When You Join


When you join us, you become part of an active community of players. To get started, fill out the membership form. Once submitted, you’ll receive access to our Discord and community updates.
